title: Practice 2: Numerals, nouns and adjectives together

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Впервые с января Дарья победила в ___ (три) матчах подряд.
exercises.prompt: This is the first time since January that Daria won three matches in a row.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: These three stars form the Belt of Orion.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I lived there for three years.
exercises.why: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много, Несколько, Мало, Сколько.» — Wikibooks, «Genitive case».
